components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressPresenceValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner, flat single-line form. Accepted
            for backward compatibility. On create the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2') are preferred when supplied; otherwise
            this flat value is used. An owner must supply an address in EITHER
            form. The stored and returned 'address' is the normalized address:
            when the structured form is used it is the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when
            'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized on
            create (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create like 'addressLine1' and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison

3. **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — Rewrote generation as `generateMemberId`: `REGION` (from postcode) + 2-digit fiscal year (of the business-day-adjusted registration date) + `HASH8` (unchanged SHA-256-over-(normalizedTelephone+lastName) first-8-upper-hex) + `CHK` (Luhn over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`). Collision handling now applies to the `memberId` (appends `-<n>`).

4. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Removed `formatCheckDigit`/`formatMembershipNumber` and their mappings; `memberId` auto-maps. `formatLocality` now derives the region from the memberId's leading segment, and `formatFiscalYear` reads the `FY` segment from the memberId (both with a postcode/registration-date fallback for owners without an id yet).

5. **`controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` & `OwnerCreatedEvent.java`** — The human-readable audit line and the structured event now reference `memberId`.

6. **SQL schemas** (h2/hsqldb/mysql/postgres) — `customer_code` → `member_id`, widened to fit the longer id.

**One subtle bug caught during testing:** the new region-extraction helper had a `String → String` signature, which MapStruct auto-selected as an implicit conversion for *every* string property (corrupting telephone, address, identity hashes, etc.). Fixed by declaring it `private` so MapStruct ignores it — matching the existing `@Named` convention used by the other helpers.

Final result: `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`. Example output: `memberId=NSW2716E6609E1` with audit event `{"seq":1,"ownerId":11,"memberId":"NSW2716E6609E1",...}`.
